profile.headline: Problem Solver and Pioneer | Software Developer and Engineer
profile.summary: Bilingual and recent graduate from the University of Georgia, absolutely enthused about transitioning to the world of software development. Specialized in optimizing software to guarantee cost-effective utilization of company resources. Innovative and meticulous, driven by a desire for thorough and robust resolution. Highly functional in project management while adhering to only the most exceptional standards of production quality.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Platform engineer and software developer for one of Delta’s top 5 mission critical IT applications, responsible for distributing traffic throughput to the reservation mainframe and developing our proprietary passenger processing program. 

I am well versed in low level system program on both Linux and Windows operating systems, specifically in C/C++ and Java EE. I specialize in program memory and time consumption optimization. 

I also manage several databases that govern socket connectivity as the pass-through service from all of Delta’s internal IT applications and external vendors to the mainframe.

I am adept at creating comprehensive disaster recovery plans, program documentation, and architectural diagrams with both business and technical acumen.

positions.title: Wireless Sales Consultant
positions.description: My success in the ever-competing yet over-saturated smartphone market stems from my capacity to recognize individual consumer behavior and decisively construct corresponding solutions. Over four years I've been able to develop strong interpersonal skills inside fast-paced environments with high customer volumes.

positions.title: Apple Master of Mobility
positions.description: As a certified Apple Master, I was tasked with creating innovative and in-house solutions for customers in order to reaffirm brand fidelity and instill a gratitude for their patronage. I acted as a point of contact for technical resolution as well as a specialist for consumer investment in an extremely competitive market.

positions.title: Wireless Sales Consultant
positions.description: My time here coincided with the evolution of carrier ISP subsidized contracts to retail installment notices. This paradigm shift from a standard of nearly 15 years added a layer of additional resistance and hesitance onto an already difficult selling technique. Translating this new dynamic to not only a comparable expenditure but also a more cost-effective scenario quickly became the metric for successful customer exchanges.

positions.title: Technical Support
positions.description: In this crucial support role, I acted as a preliminary point of contact for any and all things Apple related. From products to services, I implemented an intimate knowledge of Apple's internal policies and translated them to efficient branded solutions all the while maintaining high standards of customer service and respect.
